Serving award winning Italian cuisine in Mississauga since 1981
Since opening in 1981 these classic dishes have been long-time favourites and are still featured on our menus today.

Our Capelli di Angeli with lobster sauce has been the most popular dish since 1985. This delicious dish is made with fresh lobster meat and served with delicate angel hair pasta, creating a perfect balance of flavours.
This linguine pasta dish (shown in photo) featuring fresh shrimp, scallops, mussels and clams in a white wine garlic basil tomato sauce has been a seafood lovers dream since 1981.
Veal Scaloppine can come in many forms but this classic Italian dish features tender veal topped with eggplant, capicollo and bocconcini cheese in basil garlic tomato sauce.
We are very pleased to offer reservations online and by phone!
Thank you so much for all of your continued support!

Established in 1981 by Michael Morra Sr., Michael’s Back Door Restaurant has been providing Mississauga and the GTA with award winning Italian cuisine and professional courteous service in a warm, comfortable atmosphere for 44 years.
Principal owner Michael Morra Jr., along with partner and Chef Mark D’Souza invite you to experience creative Italian, continental fare, offering the freshest ingredients and a variety of rare wines.

Head Chef, Mark D'Souza, joined Michael's Back Door in 2015. Since becoming the head of the kitchen, Mark and his team have focused on adding a modern twist to our traditional rustic and regional Italian dishes.
Whether you are looking for a quick, casual family dinner, a romantic night out or an opportunity to catch up with friends, Michael’s Back Door has the perfect table for you.

Michael’s Back Door offers a variety of well appointed private and semi-private dining areas that accommodate up to 42 guests or up to 80 with a buyout. Customized menus, table setup and table decor are just a few of the many services we provide.
Located in the main dining room, beautifully sun-drenched by day, warm & elegant by night, the Solarium can accommodate a private group of 30 to 42 or semi-private of 16 to 22 guests.

Welcome to the Wine Room, our private dining space designed for 10 to 18 guests. This warm and intimate setting is perfect for dinner meetings, family celebrations, and special events, providing a cozy atmosphere memories are made

Welcome to Upstairs at Michael's, our newly renovated private room designed to host gatherings for 20 to 42 people. This inviting space is perfect for celebrations, meetings, or intimate events. With modern decor and a warm ambiance, it offers an ideal backdrop for unforgettable moments.

To purchase a traditional plastic gift card please call us at 905-822-5751 or visit our restaurant at 1715 Lakeshore Road West, Mississauga from Tuesday to Sunday between the hours of 3pm-9pm.

Perfect for the last minute gift or for someone who lives far away from you. A Michael's Back Door e-card allows you to send a gift card via email to friends and family. The recipient will be notified once the purchase has been made and will be able to redeem it by printing it out or showing us the email on their phone.
